outcome_summary: Starved while mandatory piranha chest remained uncollected
incoming_learnings: Distinguish inaccessible mandatory loot from completed loot. Healing to full health does not restore potion-test eligibility while starving. Check the actual preparation gate before blaming potion protection or extending fallback waits. Preserve public identification, hazard checks and mandatory progression; selecting preparation alone would not prove extinguishing or retrieval.

review.review: The run died from hunger: decision 2358, accepted log line 6921, explicitly reports starvation death. The initiating pool blockage preceded starvation. Invisibility was publicly identified at decision 553 (accepted line 1589), yet full-health fallback resumed at decision 564 (line 1616). Original-source offline reconstruction matched selections through 564. The only budgeted protected chest route started at closed entrance 1287; puzzle_supplies.stage_known_pool excluded doorway origins even for identified invisibility. The focused candidate permits guarded ordinary doorway staging, without changing unknown-potion tests, hazard exclusions, protection budgets or mandatory collection. Its first changed selection is decision 557, an observed approach step; reconstruction stops there. The new regression fails on original source and passes on the candidate; the full suite passes 1,569 tests with four skips. This does not establish successful opening, protection, chest retrieval or survival. The other backlog cases remain unresolved; their stated missing evidence is unchanged.
review.learnings: Distinguish unknown-potion test banks from staging identified invisibility. A guarded entrance doorway may be the only origin within the protected round-trip budget. Open and reobserve before spending protection; require actual buffs and collection evidence. Choosing preparation is not puzzle completion.

recommendations.reason: The full helper chain is available and already delegates inaccessible pickups to guarded supplies. Here starvation blocks preparation before the frost preflight; a bandolier is present, so missing protection is not established as the blocker. A safe correction needs a contemporaneously known identification/extinguishing resource or a recorded-input-validated preparation alternative satisfying hunger, health, hazard, bank/protection and retrieval budgets. None is certified. Unknown potion identities revealed on death cannot supply that evidence, and neither relaxing test admission nor waiving mandatory pickup is justified.
